hero_sub: A Twitch or YouTube recording, or a video file. Everything happens on this computer, and you can watch every step.
source_ph: A link to a stream recording, or a path to a video
drop_here: Drop the video — it starts at once
v_not_yet: VodCut does not write this yet.
no_render: Only find clips, do not render
no_jobs: No requests yet. Paste a link above.
stop_now_text: The step that is running ({step}) is cut off and done again on «Continue»; everything finished before it stays. «Pause» instead waits for the end of the step and loses nothing.
pause_note: SMTV stops when «{step}» is finished, so nothing is lost. A long step (speech to text) can take a while.
episodes_empty: Moments appear as the AI reads what was said on stream.
ev_model: Downloading the speech model: {p}% ({d} of {t} GB)
ev_missing_scan: The AI did not answer for {d} of {t} parts of the recording. «Run again» asks only for them
ev_missing_rating: The AI did not rate {d} of {t} moments. «Run again» asks only for them
ev_missing_look: The AI did not look at {d} of {t} parts of the recap: no close-up of the camera and no ad blur there
ev_missing_fit: The AI did not trim {d} of {t} clips exactly: they keep the bounds as picked
ev_missing_critic: The AI did not check {d} of {t} clips: they are made, but unchecked
load_failed: Could not load {w}. Open the request again in a moment
opt_loudness_about: Every clip is as loud as other shorts in the feed (−14 LUFS)
opt_bleep_about: Slurs against groups of people get a tone; ordinary swearing stays
opt_peak_lines_about: The clip ends on its key phrase in big letters
opt_ad_blur_about: Sponsor logos and promo codes in the frame get blurred. The AI looks at each clip once more
opt_precise_about: The clip starts right where the event starts and keeps the punchline — no idle lead-in. A little slower: about 10–20 s per 4 clips
yt_sign_in: YouTube does not give this video without signing in. Download the recording and choose the file.
link_no_account: Links through a StreamMoment account are coming soon. For now, choose the recording file from your computer, or turn on «Download links myself» in VodCut's settings: then the yt-dlp program downloads links on this computer (Settings → Computer check installs it).
opt_critic_about: The AI checks every finished clip like an editor: the streamer's webcam in place, the face not covered, no black bars. If something is off, it fixes it once and keeps the better version. About 15 s per clip
fix_layout_split_equal: webcam and game in equal halves
opt_local_download_about: On: the yt-dlp program downloads links to Twitch and YouTube on this computer — install it in Settings → Computer check. Off: links go through a StreamMoment account, which is coming soon; a video file works either way. At your own risk: platforms change often, YouTube may ask to sign in
opt_recap_about: After the clips, a 20–30 minute video of the whole stream is made — for YouTube. The AI picks the story; the video is put together on this computer: about 6 min for a 2-hour stream
recap_off: The recap is off. With it on, a 20–30 minute video of the whole stream is made after the clips.
recap_wait: A 20–30 minute video of the whole stream, made after the clips.
recap_none: No recap was made for this request.
recap_skipped: The AI found nothing worth a recap in this stream.
post_text_about: Copy the text for publishing: the title, the channel, the link
agent.scan.title: Finding moments
agent.scan.short: Reads what was said on stream and finds the moments worth a clip.
agent.scan.does: Reads the whole transcript in overlapping ten-minute windows and marks the episodes worth a clip.
agent.scan.needs: up to an hour of transcript per call
agent.scan.why: Strong: it reads an hour of transcript at once and must not miss a story.
agent.rating.title: Rating
agent.rating.short: Rates each moment, keeps the best part and writes the clip's title.
agent.rating.does: Rates each episode, picks its best 15–60 seconds and writes a title in the stream's language.
agent.rating.needs: a few episodes with their context
agent.rating.why: Medium: short pieces of text, but the verdict and the title need judgement.
agent.fit.title: Exact cut
agent.fit.short: Trims the start and the end, so the clip has no idle lead-in.
agent.fit.does: Reads the 70 seconds around each picked clip word by word and moves its start and end to the words where the event begins and ends: no idle lead-in, the punchline and its reaction kept. Only with «More precise» on.
agent.fit.needs: up to four 70-second windows: words with ids and times, pauses, loudness
agent.fit.why: Medium: little text, but it must cite exact word ids and keep millisecond arithmetic right (15–70 s, no cut words); production cuts with a light model and a repair request, a medium one needs fewer repairs.
agent.recap.title: Recap story
agent.recap.short: Builds the story of a long recap video from the whole stream.
agent.recap.does: Reads the rated episodes and the whole transcript and builds the story of a 20–30 minute recap: the parts of the stream that stay, in stream order, with chapters, the moments where the webcam comes forward, and the video's title. Only with «Recap» on.
agent.recap.needs: the whole transcript of the stream (up to 240,000 characters) and the episodes
agent.recap.why: Strong: one call holds the whole stream and must keep its story, its order and exact timestamps; production writes recaps with a strong model.
request.title: Stream recording
request.about: Twitch, YouTube or a video file → clips
tool.about:
VodCut turns a stream recording into vertical clips, on this computer.

It takes the sound of a Twitch or YouTube recording (or a video file), turns speech into text, lets the model find and rate the moments, picks the best ones and edits each into a 9:16 clip: the streamer's camera and the game, captions, a hook at the start, the loudness of shorts, a tone over slurs and blurred ads.

You watch every step live, and the clips appear one by one as they are made.
